description: This file defines various employee management services, including functions for fetching, updating, and managing employee data, attendance, performance, leaves, and announcements. It provides API interaction logic with graceful fallbacks to mock data for development or offline usage.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Utility function to determine the base URL for API calls, using environment variables.

methods.name: fetchEmployees
methods.description: Fetches a list of employees from the API or returns mock data.

methods.name: fetchEmployeeById
methods.description: Fetches a single employee by ID from the API or returns mock data if unavailable.

methods.name: updateEmployee
methods.description: Updates employee data via the API or performs a mock update.

methods.name: fetchAttendance
methods.description: Fetches attendance records for employees, with optional filtering.

methods.name: fetchPerformance
methods.description: Retrieves performance rating history for a specific employee.

methods.name: fetchLeaves
methods.description: Fetches leave requests with optional filters.

methods.name: approveLeave
methods.description: Approves or rejects a leave request.
